capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia R1T: the Max pack was later revised to 142 kWh usable (Gen 2 Max 141.5 in Green Car Reports).

chemistry.notes: autoevolution: Max pack uses Samsung 53G NCA cells.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EPA filing relayed by InsideEVs: pack voltage 216-459 V, the 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Navigation-triggered battery preconditioning plus manual battery preconditioning (no longer forced to use navigation) added by software 2025.18 for Gen 1 and Gen 2 (current state for owners). Before 2025.18 it was navigation-only.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: Gen 1 Max pack rated 149 kWh.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the EPA test documents state a peak of 210 kW for both the R1T and R1S without naming a pack (Drive Tesla Canada, InsideEVs); no Max-specific rating found. Max tests peaked 207-221 kW. Owner call: lineup-wide EPA figure applied to the Max pack.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs quoting the EPA filing for the Gen 1 R1: 11.5 kW onboard charger. Wikipedia lists 11.52 kW (240 V, 48 A).
